verses.1: And after many years, when Jehovah took Israel out of all their troubles around them, a prophet came in those days.
verses.2: And Joshua called out to all of Israel, to their elders, leaders, judges, and officers. He said to them, “I am old now; I have reached my old age.”
verses.3: And you have seen all that Jehovah your God has done for these nations from before your eyes. For Jehovah your God is the one who fights for you.
verses.4: See, I have brought to you these remaining nations from the land of Jordan. And all those nations that I have recognized… And the great sea brings the sun’s rays.
verses.5: And Jehovah your God will drive them away from before you. He will remove them from among you, and you shall take possession of their land, just as Jehovah your God has commanded you.
verses.6: May you be greatly strengthened in your efforts to keep and carry out all that is written in the Book of Moses. May not a single word of it be forgotten.
verses.7: Do not go to these nations that remain among you. Do not mention their names, nor worship them, nor serve them, nor bow down to them.
verses.8: For if you continue to act in accordance with Jehovah your God, as you have done until today, then everything will be well.
verses.9: And Yahweh will take away from you great and powerful nations. And no one has ever stood against you until today.
verses.10: One man among you will be pursued by a thousand others. For Jehovah your God is the one who will fight for you, just as He has said to you.
verses.11: And you shall keep yourselves strictly for your souls, so that you may love the LORD your God.
verses.12: For if you return and become united with these remaining nations, then you will be under their rule. They will rule over you, and you will be under their control.
verses.13: Know that Jehovah your God will not destroy these nations from before you. They will remain a source of trouble and hardship for you, and they will be a source of amusement for you. They will be a source of mockery in your eyes, until you are destroyed from this good land that Jehovah your God has given you.
verses.14: And now, I am going today along the paths of all the earth. Know this in your hearts and in your souls: not a single one of the good things that Jehovah your God has spoken to you has failed to come to pass for you. Not a single thing has been forgotten by Him.
verses.15: And just as all the good things that Jehovah your God has spoken about were brought upon you, so too will Jehovah bring upon you all the bad things. He will destroy you from this good land that Jehovah your God has given you.
verses.16: When you break the covenant with Yahweh, your God, who commanded you to serve Him and obey His laws, and instead you serve other gods and worship them. Then Yahweh will be angry with you, and you will die quickly from this good land that He has given you.
